$comment: World 'rd-own-views' (#8005, R&D), layered over rd-today: the same Monday, after Eric has written into R&D himself. On Friday evening he stated a view of his own on CRWV that would steer his bot's CRWV wheel (saved, not yet handed over — the house's AI-dip view still steers that pair), and at lunch today he drafted a playbook of his own for his bot to run. So R&D shows a member's own conviction view, the house's view steering the same pair, and his own draft beside the house's playbooks: the two meanings of 'conviction' IA §5.4 records as undecided, on one page. Both are written through production's own handlers into production's own stores at compose (member-stores.mjs); every stamp is the store's, and a write the handler refuses stops the compose.
